verdict.rationale: Granola has its own AI Chat, so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis for this product. The evidence, however, only documents Granola as an MCP server that lets external tools like Claude and ChatGPT connect to its notes, which is the opposite role. Its built-in Chat actions (email, Slack, Calendar) are first-party integrations, not user-pluggable MCP servers, so nothing shows Granola consuming third-party MCP tools.
